Senior UI/UX Developer / Architect / Design Engineer Hybrid role in IA | WCAG 2.1 | AAA Standards | .NET |
Senior UI/UX Developer / Architect / Design Engineer
Client: State of Iowa – Department of Management (DOM)
Location: Des Moines, IA – Hybrid
Preference: Local Iowa candidates preferred
Employment Type: Contract – C2C
Interview: Web/Virtual
Visa - No visa restriction
Job Summary
The State of Iowa is seeking a Senior UI/UX Developer / Architect / Design Engineer with approximately 6+ years of experience in building and maintaining enterprise-level design systems.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in WCAG accessibility standards, front-end development, reusable component libraries, and accessible UI/UX design. The candidate will be responsible for creating and implementing scalable, reusable, and accessible components that meet Federal WCAG 2.1 accessibility requirements, including AAA standards.
The successful candidate should have experience building design systems from scratch and collaborating with multiple teams to ensure accessibility, usability, consistency, and scalability.
Mandatory Requirements
5+ years of      professional front-end development experience.
Proven experience      setting up and integrating enterprise design systems.
Experience      developing high-level wrapper components and reusable      component libraries.
Strong expertise      in WCAG 2.1 / AAA accessibility standards.
Strong knowledge      of ARIA roles and semantic HTML.
Experience with accessibility      testing tools.
Proficiency in:
HTML
SASS
Angular
Experience using Storybook for      component development, documentation, and collaboration.
Strong understanding      of UX principles and accessible user interface design.
Experience with USWDS      (U.S. Web Design System) or other enterprise-level design      systems.
Familiarity with backend      technologies including:
.NET
MVC
SQL
Understanding of backend      considerations in a .NET environment to support seamless      front-end integration.
Excellent communication      and collaboration skills.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure UI components      comply with WCAG 2.1 / AAA accessibility requirements.
Implement ARIA roles and      semantic HTML best practices.
Develop and maintain      component documentation using Storybook.
Integrate front-end      components with backend systems in a .NET/MVC environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Local candidates      residing in Iowa are preferred.
Previous experience      working with State Government or public-sector projects.
Experience implementing      enterprise design systems from scratch.
Strong understanding of      accessibility compliance and testing.

description:
**Job Title: Full Stack Engineer (UI Engineer)**
**Location: Sacramento, CA (Onsite)**
**Contract:C2C**
**Primary Focus**
 Design and implement secure, accessible, and business\-friendly full\-stack applications using Blazor, .NET Core, and REST APIs, supporting delegated administration and approved business workflows.
   

  

 Design and implement an accessible, business\-friendly portal experience for delegated Amazon Connect administration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Design and implement the React and TypeScript user interface for all approved BOP capabilities.
   

  

 Create role\-based navigation, guided forms, search, filtering, selection, confirmations, status, and audit\-history experiences.
   

  

 Translate technical Amazon Connect concepts into clear business language and safe administration workflows.
   

  

 Implement client\-side validation, impact warnings, safe defaults, before and after summaries, and clear outcome messages.
   

  

 Integrate frontend components with authenticated BOP backend APIs without exposing privileged credentials or operations.
   

  

 Implement applicable EDD accessibility, responsive\-design, browser\-compatibility, usability, and design\-system requirements.
   

  

 Create component, interaction, end\-to\-end, accessibility, error\-state, and regression tests.
   

  

 Participate in user reviews, demonstrations, defect resolution, documentation, and iterative improvement.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Five or more years of modern web application development experience.
   

  

 Strong React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and frontend architecture skills.
   

  

 Experience building role\-based enterprise applications with complex forms, validation, workflows, and API integration.
   

  

 Knowledge of accessible web application practices, including WCAG\-aligned design and keyboard and screen\-reader considerations.
   

  

 Experience with frontend automated testing, secure session handling, safe error presentation, and performance optimization.
   

  

 Ability to collaborate with business users and convert operational requirements into clear and usable experiences.
